  > 
  > The paper's §5.2 reports the Arrhythmia d=279 extension (numbers verified against results/tables/large_d_arrhythmia*.csv: they match). The objective requires, with the code, reproduction notes with data acquisition and version, seeds, run commands, expected run time, and the script behind each table and figure. code/README.md (and REPRODUCE.md here) say nothing of the extension:
  > - Data: the loader (src/shapreliab/data.py, arrhythmia()) reads $SHAPRELIAB_DATA/arrhythmia/arrhythmia.data, but no step says to download it (UCI id 5, DOI 10.24432/C5BS32, version/date as in data.md) or where to put it; the README says 'the loaders fetch them', which is not true for this one.
  > - Commands: scripts/large_d_arrhythmia.py (prep | run MODEL START END R) and scripts/large_d_table.py appear only in the script docstring and results/README.md, not in the Pipeline table with arguments used (R=20, 40 instances, models) and cost (2.36 CPU-h).
  > - 'Where each reported number is computed': add the §5.2 d=279 paragraph (strict/tolerance P_c, share, TreeSHAP additivity count 7 of 40) -> large_d_table.py / large_d_arrhythmia*.csv.
  > 
  > Needed: a short addition to code/README.md (and REPRODUCE.md if it is a separate delivery), then pushed through paper-repo to dev and main. No new computation. This is the one open must on the final version.
